sections.content:
Interesting! The batch was interrupted after 5 actions (all middle row red clicks). The bottom row red click wasn't executed. This is because the `intent='explore'` default stopped the batch when one of the actions was detected as `no_impact`.
Looking at the results:
- After 5 middle row red clicks: (26.5, 35.5) is now 'b' ✓
- But (35.5, 35.5) is still 'p' (bottom row wasn't shifted)
- Level not completed
So the middle row shift worked, but the level isn't complete yet. I still need to shift the bottom row. Let me also check if the left column at (26.5, 23.5) changed - it went from 'b' to 'S'. This is because shifting the middle row also changes the block at the left column intersection.
Wait, but the left column at (26.5, 23.5) is now 'S', not 'b'. This means my hypothesis about matching left and right columns is wrong, because the left column changed too.
Let me reconsider. The yellow markers are at (26.5, 35.5) and (35.5, 35.5). After shifting the middle row, (26.5, 35.5) is now 'b'. But the level isn't complete, so I still need to shift the bottom row.
Let me try shifting the bottom row left by 1 (click red 1 time) to get 'b' at (35.5, 35.5).
But wait, I need to first understand why the batch was interrupted. Looking at the executed actions, only 5 middle row red clicks were executed. The bottom row red click wasn't executed. This might be because the 5th middle row red click was detected as `no_impact` (maybe the middle row has a period of 5, so clicking red 5 times returns to the original state?).
Actually, looking more carefully, the middle row has 10 blocks. Shifting left by 5 positions is not the same as the original state (shifting by 10 would return to original). So the 5th click should have had an impact.
Wait, let me re-read the output. It says "Executed actions: MOUSE(row=26, col=14), MOUSE(row=26, col=14), MOUSE(row=26, col=14), MOUSE(row=26, col=14), MOUSE(row=26, col=14)." - all 5 middle row red clicks were executed. The bottom row click wasn't executed because the batch was stopped.
But why was the batch stopped? The `intent='explore'` default stops on `no_impact`. Maybe one of the 5 middle row clicks was detected as `no_impact`? But the output shows all 5 were executed...
Actually, looking at the output more carefully, it says "Executed actions" with 5 entries, all middle row red clicks. The bottom row click is not in the list. So the batch was stopped after the 5 middle row clicks, before the bottom row click.
This could be because the 5th middle row click was detected as `no_impact` (maybe the game has some periodicity or the detection is imperfect). Or it could be that the batch was stopped for another reason.
Regardless, I need to now shift the bottom row. Let me do that.
